captions.detailed: A wall-mounted air purifier featuring a slim, light-gray rectangular housing with rounded corners. A dark-gray flat wall bracket is attached to the rear of the unit. On the front, a flat gray cover panel is secured by two prominent black revolute hinge knuckles on one side, allowing it to swing open. A rectangular filter cartridge is designed to slide out vertically from the rear of the housing along prismatic guide rails.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a wall-hung air purifier. It should feature a main rectangular housing with rounded corners, a flat rear wall bracket, a front cover panel attached via two revolute side hinges on one edge, and a slide-out filter cartridge at the back using a prismatic joint.
captions.factory: Construct the main housing body using a box primitive with filleted vertical edges, and hollow it or subtract an inner volume. Model the wall bracket as a thin flat box. Create the front cover panel using another thin plate, and attach it to the housing using two cylinder primitives representing the hinge knuckles, defining a revolute joint along their common vertical axis. Create a separate rectangular box for the filter cartridge, and define a prismatic joint relative to the housing to model its sliding motion.
